# BitLegacy Solutions LLP

> BitLegacy Solutions LLP is an India-based IT consultancy and software company. We solve business problems with research-backed technology: web and mobile development, cloud, data, cybersecurity, and IT consulting — and we build our own SaaS products, most notably BitLegacy Hotels, hotel management software for independent Indian hotels.

## About
- Legal name: BitLegacy Solutions LLP (Limited Liability Partnership, India)
- Founded: 2020
- Website: https://www.bitlegacy.org
- Business email: business@bitlegacy.org
- Support email: support@bitlegacy.org
- WhatsApp: +91 90414 91603
- Industry: Information Technology (consultancy and software products)

## Services
- Web Development — custom websites and web apps (React/Next.js, e-commerce, CMS integration)
- Mobile Solutions — native and cross-platform apps (iOS, Android, React Native, Flutter)
- Cloud Services — scalable infrastructure and migration (AWS, Azure, DevOps)
- Data Management — database design, analytics, big data, AI/ML
- Cybersecurity — security audits, compliance, monitoring
- IT Consulting — technology strategy, architecture, optimization

## Products
- BitLegacy Hotels — Hotel Management Software (PMS) for independent hotels in India.
  - URL: https://www.bitlegacy.in
  - Capabilities: front desk (rooms, bookings, guests), GST-compliant invoicing, night audit, housekeeping, restaurant & bar POS, a commission-free direct booking engine, a built-in hotel website, WhatsApp notifications, analytics, and multi-property support.
  - Pricing: plans from INR 999/month with a 60-day free trial and no setup fee.
  - Pricing page: https://www.bitlegacy.in/pricing
